Frequently asked questions

Before we get started.

Does an assessment guarantee protection?

No assessment or control can guarantee security. The goal is to identify relevant risks and prioritize practical improvements.

Can you review our current security setup?

An initial conversation can establish which systems, controls and questions should be included in a scoped review.

Can you help implement recommendations?

Implementation can be included in a proposal where it fits the engagement and required expertise.
